events.title_en: The Power of Patronage: Supporting Contemporary Art
events.title_it: Il potere del mecenatismo nell'arte contemporanea
events.summary_en: A free panel asks how collectors, organisations and micro-patrons can create a more sustainable and accessible future for contemporary artists.
events.summary_it: Un panel gratuito esplora come collezionisti, organizzazioni e micro-mecenati possano sostenere un futuro più accessibile e duraturo per gli artisti contemporanei.

advanced.reason: A focused free discussion connecting an unusual City venue with practical support for independent contemporary artists.

events.title_en: Local London Guiding Day: City Walk
events.title_it: Local London Guiding Day: passeggiata nella City
events.summary_en: Qualified City guides lead free hourly walks showing how Roman plans, medieval street names, Wren architecture and livery companies still shape modern London.
events.summary_it: Guide qualificate conducono passeggiate gratuite ogni ora, mostrando come piante romane, vie medievali, architettura di Wren e corporazioni plasmino ancora la City.

venue.name: Outside M&S Food, Cannon Street Station
venue.address: Cannon Street Station, Cannon Street, London

advanced.reason: A one-day programme of free, expert-led walks reveals how layers of London history continue to govern the modern City.

events.title_en: Hampton Court Palace Free Garden Open Days
events.title_it: Giardini gratuiti a Hampton Court Palace
events.summary_en: Explore the Great Fountain, Kitchen and Pond Gardens without the normal admission charge during one of Hampton Court's limited free garden weekends.
events.summary_it: Esplora gratuitamente Great Fountain Garden, Kitchen Garden e Pond Gardens durante uno dei rari fine settimana ad accesso libero di Hampton Court.

advanced.reason: Rare free access opens a major historic royal landscape normally covered by paid palace admission.

events.title_en: StarQuest: A Performance-Lecture by Maya Man
events.summary_en: Maya Man's London-premiere performance-lecture mixes generative software, choreography and online culture to probe competitive dance and algorithmic self-performance.
events.summary_it: La prima londinese di Maya Man mescola software generativo, coreografia e cultura online per indagare la danza competitiva e la performance algoritmica del sé.

advanced.reason: A free London premiere uses an unusual performance-lecture format to connect digital art, choreography and algorithmic culture.

events.title_en: William Morris Gallery Family Day: Welcome Home
events.title_it: Welcome Home: giornata per famiglie alla William Morris Gallery
events.summary_en: A reopening family day offers screenprinting, a first look at the redisplayed permanent collection and a new trail through William Morris's former home.
events.summary_it: Una giornata per la riapertura propone serigrafia, la collezione permanente riallestita e un nuovo percorso nella casa storica di William Morris.

venue.name: William Morris Gallery
venue.address: Lloyd Park, Forest Road, Walthamstow, London

advanced.reason: A free neighbourhood reopening day offers early access to a redisplayed collection inside William Morris's historic home.

events.summary_en: Surbiton's eccentric annual race sends costumed competitors downhill on blocks of ice, with a luge, community spectacle and free participation or viewing.
events.summary_it: L'eccentrica gara annuale di Surbiton lancia concorrenti in costume giù dalla collina su blocchi di ghiaccio, con slittino e partecipazione gratuita.

venue.name: St Mark's Hill
venue.address: Central Parade, St Mark's Hill, Surbiton

advanced.reason: A genuinely odd, free and deeply local tradition turns a Surbiton hill into a one-day community ski slope.
